name: service-alert-triad
description: Single Alert that conveys urgency for a time-sensitive event (overdue / due-soon / on-schedule). Pre-compute the variant ('warning'|'info'|'success'), title, and body into data.urgencyAlert — DO NOT use $if chains or render three separate conditional Alerts. Drop this anywhere a single status banner fits. Why one node, not three: makes the spec smaller, keeps copy editable in one place, and matches the derivation policy (variants live in data).

urgencyAlert.title: Service overdue
urgencyAlert.body: Oil change was due Mar 15, 2026. Schedule service as soon as possible.
